Name: More Upgrades
Author: Amichwan
Description:
[b]More Upgrades – Additional Building Improvements[/b]

This mod adds [b]two extra upgrade levels[/b] for existing farm buildings, expanding their space and functionality.
It includes [b]custom textures[/b] to represent new upgrade stages, but you can enable [b]Vanilla Style[/b] in the config menu to keep the original or texture mod styles.
Each building at its [b]highest upgrade level is paintable[/b].

[b][u]Barn & Coop[/u][/b]
Expands animal capacity: first upgrade allows [b]16 animals[/b], second upgrade up to [b]20 animals[/b].
The [b]Coop[/b] gains an [b]extra incubator[/b] with its first upgrade.

[b][u]Shed[/u][/b]
Adds an [b]extra room[/b]: first a small additional space, then expands that same room with the second upgrade.

[b][u]Silo[/u][/b]
Increases [b]maximum hay capacity[/b] with each upgrade level.

[b][u]Multilingual Support:[/u][/b]
All text is [b]AI-translated[/b]. Feedback on translations is welcome.


[b][u]Update 1.0.6[/u][/b]
Now fully configurable through GMCM:
Construction cost
Material requirements
Construction days

[b]Important:[/b] When configuring prices and/or materials, you must enter a numeric value. If not, the building will "break".


[b][u]Update 1.0.7[/u][/b]

Added [b]Clean versions of Coop and Barn maps[/b].
Clean maps remove decorative clutter and non-essential objects, providing a [b]simpler and more open interior layout[/b].
These versions are ideal for players who prefer a [b]minimalist look[/b] or use other mods that add furniture, machines, or custom interiors.


[b][u]Update 1.1.0[/u][/b]

[b][u]Shed Expansion Overhaul[/u][/b]

The Shed now includes [b]four additional upgrade levels[/b], expanding its progression path to:

[b]Shed → Big Shed → Deluxe Shed → Super Shed → Premium Shed → Mega Shed[/b]

Each new upgrade significantly increases available interior space, including expanded side rooms and improved layouts for large-scale production setups.

[b][u]Slime Hutch Upgrades[/u][/b]

Added two new upgrades for the [b]Slime Hutch[/b]:

[b]Big Slime Hutch[/b] – supports up to [b]40 slimes[/b].
[b]Deluxe Slime Hutch[/b] – supports up to [b]60 slimes[/b].

These upgrades also include expanded interiors and support for additional water troughs.

[b][u]Dino Expanded Compatibility[/u][/b]

Added two compatible upgrades for [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/41921]Dino Expanded[/url][/b]:

[b]Super Dino Hutch[/b] – supports up to [b]16 dinosaurs[/b].
[b]Premium Dino Hutch[/b] – supports up to [b]20 dinosaurs[/b].

These upgrades expand the building interior and increase dinosaur capacity.

[b][u]Automatic Interior Item Movement[/u][/b]

Added a small system that automatically moves certain placed objects when upgrading buildings, helping preserve interior layouts after map expansions.

[b][u]IMPORTANT[/u][/b]

The [b]NORMAL[/b] and [b]COMPATIBLE[/b] versions of the mod have now been [b]merged into a single file[/b].
Compatibility options can now be enabled or disabled directly through [b]GMCM[/b].

[b][u]WARNING FOR EXISTING SAVES[/u][/b]

If you update the mod in an advanced save, items previously placed inside the old [b]Deluxe Shed[/b] and [b]Premium Shed[/b] may appear with an empty space on the right side due to the new interior map redesign.

You can fix this by:

* moving the items manually with a mod such as [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20943]Let's Move It[/url][/b], or
* simply waiting until you build the new left-side room, which restores access to that area of the map.

[b][u]Plans for a Future Update[/u][/b]

* Add [b]Mega[/b] and [b]Hyper[/b] upgrades for the Barn, Coop, and Dino Hutch, allowing up to [b]26[/b] and [b]32 animals[/b] respectively.
  (Yes, future upgrades will continue increasing capacity by 6 animals each, and that will be the final limit.)

* Add [b]seasonal versions[/b] of buildings.

* Add expanded [b]SVE compatibility[/b].
  A new configuration option will allow SVE animals such as the [b]Bear[/b], [b]Camel[/b], and [b]Goose[/b] to unlock through this mod’s Premium building upgrades.


[b][u]Compatibility[/u][/b]

Compatible with [b]Stardew Valley Expanded (SVE)[/b].
In SVE, the [b]Premium Barn[/b] and [b]Premium Coop[/b] are [b]separate buildings[/b] that unlock after owning the Deluxe versions. This mod, instead, [b]upgrades the original Barn and Coop buildings[/b] by adding new upgrade levels to them.
Because of this, upgrading a Barn or Coop to this mod’s [b]Super / Premium tiers[/b] [b]does NOT unlock SVE-exclusive animals[/b]. To access those animals, you must still build SVE’s Premium buildings.

[b]Should not cause issues with other upgrade mods that do not overwrite the same building maps.[/b]
